Form No. 2
G. 25,000-1-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SECRET & CONFIDENTIAL
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No.
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
3512.
Special Branch Station:
No. 4 H. 38
Date: April 16, 1932.）

Subject (in full)........................................................ P.H. Rumberg (Estonian).

Made by...... D.S. Moore. ....................................Forwarded by... D.S. Moore.

Before the Great War, the above named individual resided
in Vladivostock where he was employed as a piano tuner.
Following the outbreak of the revolution in Russia he came to
Shanghai. After the cessation of the Great War hostilities,
Estonian nationals ceased to be Russian subjects and complications
immediately ensued concerning the issue of passports and visas.
Rumberg was then requested by members of the local Estonian
community, amongst whom are numbered many of the mercantile
marine fraternity, to take over the supervision and issue of
the necessary identity documents. This he did, but has on
occasions since then, expressed the desire to hand over the
reins of his honorary office to another of his nationals, but
has always been persuaded to continue.
Estonia has no agreement with China and Rumberg's
authority is confined to the issue of documents of identity and
to act as advisor to his nationals.
He is President of the Shanghai Estonian Community and
Chairman of the Estonian Benevolent Society, to which positions
he was elected by popular vote amongst the local Estonians,
amongst whom he is well liked.
Rumberg resides with his wife in the house of his
father-in-law, Mr. W.J. Kerr, S.M.C. Superintendant of Parks
and Open Spaces, at No.9 Singapore Road. This address, according
to an article which appeared in the "Slovo" of April 15, 1932,
is the residence of the Estonian Consul. Rumberg is employed
as a pianist at the Palace Hotel where he enjoys a good
reputation.

W.B. Moore
D. / S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：Sd, Please show this report to Mr. A. E. Long,
Secretary (to) Danish Consul, and request him to
regard the matter as strictly confidential.
J.P. Swaine
O. i/c Sp. Br..）

表格编号 2
G. 25,000-1-32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
秘密及机密
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案编号
刑事与特别股登记处
3512.
特别股分站：
H 区第 4 号，编号 38
日期：1932年4月16日。）

主题（全称）........................................................ P.H. Rumberg（爱沙尼亚人）。

撰写人...... D.S. Moore。 ....................................转呈人... D.S. Moore。

在大战之前，上述人士居住在符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock），受雇为钢琴调音师。
俄国革命爆发后，他来到上海。第一次世界大战敌对行动停止后，爱沙尼亚国民不再具有俄国臣民身份，随即在护照和签证签发问题上产生了复杂情况。
当时，当地爱沙尼亚社群成员（其中包括许多商船海员同业人员）请求 Rumberg 接管必要身份证明文件的监管和签发工作。他接受了这一任务，但此后曾数次表示希望将这一荣誉职务的职权移交给另一位本国同胞，但总是被说服继续留任。
爱沙尼亚与中国没有签订协定，Rumberg 的权限仅限于签发身份证明文件，并担任其本国同胞的顾问。
他是上海爱沙尼亚社群主席，也是爱沙尼亚慈善会主席，这两个职位均由当地爱沙尼亚人通过普选产生，他在这些人中颇受欢迎。
Rumberg 与其妻子居住在其岳父 W.J. Kerr 先生家中，Kerr 先生系工部局公园及空地总监，住址为新加坡路9号。根据1932年4月15日《斯洛沃报》（Slovo）刊登的一篇文章，该地址为爱沙尼亚领事馆驻地。Rumberg 受雇于宫殿饭店（Palace Hotel）担任钢琴师，享有良好声誉。

W.B. Moore
警探 / 副警探

特别股主管警官。

（批：已签，请将此报告出示给丹麦领事馆秘书 A. E. Long 先生，并请他将此事视为严格机密。
J.P. Swaine
特别股主管警官。）
